svg.title: INDEX Needle - complete cursor family for review
svg.desc: Fourteen roles in selected concept B styling. Each card has two enlarged views and 24, 32, 48 pixel samples on dark and light. Final cards show eight animation frames in order, at 80 milliseconds each. No theme activated. Actual sizes apply at 100 percent zoom.

g.aria-label: WHITE EDGE + DARK OUTLINE / NO APPLY
